functions.name: commits
functions.description: Canonical repository-qualified commits. Repository history follows the selected ref or default branch, not all branches or unreachable objects. Every discovered commit is hydrated by SHA for consistent stats and account metadata. Original Git author and committer identities are distinct; GitHub account associations may be absent and are not inferred from email.

metrics.name: commit_count
metrics.comment: Canonical repository-qualified commits. Repository history follows the selected ref or default branch, not all branches or unreachable objects. Every discovered commit is hydrated by SHA for consistent stats and account metadata. Original Git author and committer identities are distinct; GitHub account associations may be absent and are not inferred from email.

derived_fields.name: authored_day
derived_fields.comment: UTC original-author date; not the committer date or a GitHub account activity attribution.

derived_fields.name: committed_day
derived_fields.comment: UTC commit-creation date recorded by the committer, distinct from original-author time.

commit_added_lines.comment: Sum of GitHub commit-stat added-line observations over selected commit identities. Repeated edits across commits count repeatedly; not unique surviving lines.

commit_deleted_lines.comment: Sum of GitHub deleted-line observations over selected commit identities; not unique lines or a productivity score.

functions.name: commit_pull_request_memberships
functions.description: Explicit commit-to-PR associations. GitHub returns the merged PR introducing a default-branch commit, or merged/open associated PRs for commits outside the default branch.
